payload.criteria:
The vital few (definition | requirement id | weight):
1. Correctness-live - the routed iteration actually runs live end-to-end, no silent breakage | R3, R7 | 0.30.
2. Least-machinery - fewest new moving parts; reuse i5 primitives + the machine compiler | affordability of the R-set | 0.20.
3. No-wedge robustness - a bad state or missing tree cannot wedge the loop for ALL iterations; failures are contained and named | R1, R5 | 0.20.
4. DRY single-source - one place knows where an iteration lives; no duplicated routing/state logic | owner DRY law | 0.15.
5. Mechanical, no-LLM-judgment - provisioning and routing are automatic; the agent never decides where an iteration runs | owner ruling 'bake into the machinery' | 0.15.
